<h3 id="cn-v0.4.8">插件 0.4.8 — 已验证 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.4</h3>

### 版本对应

| 插件 | 已验证 DSH | npm |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `0.4.8` | `0.2.1-rc.4` 及此前十一个已验证版本 | 本次发布，`latest` |
| `0.4.7` | `0.2.1-rc.3` 及此前十个已验证版本 | 已发布 |

### 更新原因与调整

- **为 DSH `0.2.1-rc.4` 追加兼容声明。** `0.2.1-rc.4` 是 npm 上最新的发布版——目前由 `next` 标签承载，`latest` 仍指向 `0.2.1-rc.2`——加入已验证清单后，面板不会再把你正在运行的版本标成“尚未验证兼容”。**功能代码没有任何改动。**
- **为什么需要这次发布：** 宿主已经升级到比清单最后一项更新的版本，面板的兼容标签因此落后一档，尽管插件依赖的接口并没有变化。
- **是核对过的，不是假设的。** 把其注入依赖闭包里的十六个包（`dsh-api-remotes`、`dsh-client-connection`、`dsh-client-ui-{layout,sidebar,settings,settings-general,slots,renderer,theme}`、`dsh-settings`、`dsh-client-modules`、`dsh-api-gateway`、`dsh-api-settings-controller`、`dsh-home-paths`、`dsh-terminal`、`dsh-agent`）的 rc.3 与 rc.4 发布包逐一比对，未发现类型声明或导出变化，差异只有 `package.json` 的版本号和三处构建时写入的版本/提交号（侧栏构建标记、设置 → 通用里的版本行、client-modules 的提交号）。在实际运行的 rc.4 宿主上，`POST /api/dsh-update-status.get-status` 返回 `200` 且 `currentVersion` 为 `0.2.1-rc.4`，重启状态接口同样有应答，启动记录里的 `instanceId` 与该进程一致；`__DSH_BOOT__` 中本插件的客户端入口存在、六个注入包齐全，宿主下发的浏览器包除末尾两行 source map 重写（补 `;`、改写 `//# sourceMappingURL=??…&rev=…`）外与本次构建一致。宿主日志里没有与本插件相关的兼容拒载或报错。另外两个声明为 peer 的 `@deepseek-ai/cordis` 4.0.5 与 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 3.18.5 走独立版本线，也都落在本插件声明的范围内。
- **引擎范围本来就接纳 rc.4。** `>=0.1.7-alpha.2 <0.3.0` 配合 `includePrerelease: true` 已经包含它，因此 `dsh.engines.dsh` 与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings` peer 均无需改动；只有两处已验证声明（`dsh.compatibility.dshReleases` 与 `VERIFIED_DSH_VERSIONS`）各增加一项，并保持两者一致，由现有测试守住。
- **中英文 README 一并核对。** 示例 `npm install -g` 命令、SemVer 比较示例、已验证版本清单、“最新发布”的措辞（npm 的 `latest` 仍是 `0.2.1-rc.2`，因此文档不再把任何一个 DSH 版本称作“当前版”）、引擎范围里的版本计数（十一 → 十二）、版本对照表（`0.4.8` 为 `latest`，`0.4.7` 转为已发布）以及按版本安装的命令清单，现在都指向 `0.2.1-rc.4`；那份清单此前漏掉了 `0.4.6` 一行，本次一并补回。发布检查清单里过时的“通道选择”一项也已删除。

### 兼容性与升级

DSH 范围保持 `>=0.1.7-alpha.2 <0.3.0`。已验证：`0.2.1-rc.4`、`0.2.1-rc.3`、`0.2.1-rc.2`、`0.2.1-alpha.5`、`0.2.1-alpha.4`、`0.2.1-alpha.3`、`0.2.1-alpha.1`、`0.2.0-rc.2`、`0.2.0-rc.1`、`0.1.7-rc.2`、`0.1.7-rc.1` 与 `0.1.7-alpha.2`。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-update-status@0.4.8
```

升级后重新加载页面。若宿主提示需重启，请在当前任务完成后按提示重启。219 项测试、两处类型检查、构建、依赖防护检查与打包产物核对均通过；发布前已解包比对：除 `package.json` 外 19 个文件与工作树逐字节相同，`package.json` 仅有发布时的规范化差异（去掉 `prepack` 脚本与本地 `packageManager` 字段）。本次未进行刷新后的真实页面视觉验收。

<h3 id="en-v0.4.8">Plugin 0.4.8 — verified against DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.4</h3>

### Version matrix

| Plugin | Verified DSH | npm |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `0.4.8` | `0.2.1-rc.4` and the eleven previously verified releases | This release, `latest` |
| `0.4.7` | `0.2.1-rc.3` and the ten previously verified releases | published |

### Why this update and what changed

- **Adds DSH `0.2.1-rc.4` to the verified list.** `0.2.1-rc.4` is the newest release npm publishes — carried today by the `next` dist-tag while `latest` still names `0.2.1-rc.2` — so the panel stops labelling the release you are actually running as compatibility unverified. **No functional code changed.**
- **Why it was needed:** the Host had been upgraded past the list's last entry, so the compatibility label sat one release behind reality even though none of the interfaces this plugin relies on had moved.
- **Checked, not assumed.** Comparing the rc.3 and rc.4 tarballs of the sixteen packages in its injected dependency closure (`dsh-api-remotes`, `dsh-client-connection`, `dsh-client-ui-{layout,sidebar,settings,settings-general,slots,renderer,theme}`, `dsh-settings`, `dsh-client-modules`, `dsh-api-gateway`, `dsh-api-settings-controller`, `dsh-home-paths`, `dsh-terminal`, `dsh-agent`) found no declaration or export change: only `package.json` version pins and three build-embedded version/commit strings differ (the sidebar build badge, the Settings → General version row and the client-modules commit id). Under the running rc.4 Host, `POST /api/dsh-update-status.get-status` answers `200` with `currentVersion: "0.2.1-rc.4"`, the restart-status endpoint answers too, the boot record's `instanceId` matches that process, and the client entry is present in `__DSH_BOOT__` with all six injected packages and the served bundle is this build apart from the Host's own two-line source-map rewrite (an appended `;` and a rewritten `//# sourceMappingURL=??…&rev=…`). The Host log shows no compatibility refusal and no error from this plugin. Its two other declared peers, `@deepseek-ai/cordis` 4.0.5 and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 3.18.5, ride independent version lines and sit inside the ranges this plugin declares.
- **The engine range already admitted rc.4.** `>=0.1.7-alpha.2 <0.3.0` with `includePrerelease: true` accepts it, so neither `dsh.engines.dsh` nor the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings` peer changed; only the two verified-release declarations (`dsh.compatibility.dshReleases` and `VERIFIED_DSH_VERSIONS`) gained an entry, and they stay in step so the existing test keeps them honest.
- **Both READMEs were re-checked.** The sample `npm install -g` command, the SemVer examples, the verified-release list, the "newest published" wording (npm's `latest` is still `0.2.1-rc.2`, so no DSH release is called "current" any more), the engine-range count ("eleven" → "twelve"), the version matrix (`0.4.8` = `latest`, `0.4.7` = published) and the explicit install-command list now all name `0.2.1-rc.4`; that list was also missing its `0.4.6` line and has it back. The stale "release-channel selection" item is gone from the release checklist.

### Compatibility and upgrade

The DSH range remains `>=0.1.7-alpha.2 <0.3.0`. Verified: `0.2.1-rc.4`, `0.2.1-rc.3`, `0.2.1-rc.2`, `0.2.1-alpha.5`, `0.2.1-alpha.4`, `0.2.1-alpha.3`, `0.2.1-alpha.1`, `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.1.7-rc.2`, `0.1.7-rc.1` and `0.1.7-alpha.2`.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-update-status@0.4.8
```

Reload the page after upgrading. If the Host asks for a restart, do so after current work finishes. All 219 tests, both type checks, the build, the dependency guard pass, and the packed artifact was unpacked and compared before tagging — all 19 files other than `package.json` are byte-identical to the worktree and `package.json` differs only by the publish-time normalization (the `prepack` script is stripped and the local `packageManager` field dropped); no refreshed-page visual acceptance was run for this build.
